scope: OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4.1 Flash monthly usage limits.

previous.note: Previous Go and Go Plus limits from the October 20 catalog; Teams $85 recorded earlier on October 30.

observed.windowRule: Per-model windows: 5-hour 20%, weekly 50%, monthly 100% of the monthly limit.
observed.promotionNote: The DeepSeek rows in the documentation showed no limited-time label or expiry at collection. Absence of a label does not establish permanence.
observed.scopeNote: Go Teams is $20 per member, with each member receiving their own limits; Go Plus and Go Teams do not currently have adopted rows in this repository.

adoptionStatus: Go $100 monthly limit adopted; Go Plus and Go Teams remain research only.
followUp: Recheck the source when the catalog changes; request estimates are cross-checks and not the allowance formula.

calculation.note: 216,670 requests at 410 input, 71,300 cached-read, 310 output tokens per request, using off-peak prices; estimates are rounded by the provider.
